semiconductor_relevance: Low — SAM PRODUCTS PVT LTD specializes in clean room products and air management systems, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SAM PRODUCTS PVT LTD is an Indian manufacturer focused on clean room and allied products, including air showers and air curtains. Their offerings are designed to maintain dust-free environments, which can be beneficial in semiconductor fabrication facilities.

regional_presence.India: The company is based in India and promotes its products as part of the 'MAKE IN INDIA' initiative.
